plan.motionDescription: Both arms smoothly raise dumbbells laterally out to the sides until roughly horizontal and lower them back down to the hips.
rejectionCriteria: Dumbbells or hands cut off by the camera frame at top of the raise
Side angle or oblique camera perspective
Camera moving or panning with the exercise
Multiple people visible in the gym background
Rapid cuts or edited speed ramps
Single-arm variation instead of bilateral raise
